# 📦 Release Checklist

- [ ] Exact source commit recorded.
- [ ] Python and dependency versions recorded.
- [ ] Compilation passes.
- [ ] Pytest passes.
- [ ] All intended Streamlit entry points smoke-tested.
- [ ] Algorithm limitations visible in user-facing docs.
- [ ] No private data, credentials or generated artifacts committed.
- [ ] Dependency changes reviewed.
- [ ] Deployment target and access settings reviewed.
- [ ] Rollback revision selected.
- [ ] Changelog and release notes updated.

## Evidence
Link CI run, test output and manual validation record.
